name: PageSpeedCare Social Chat Widget
author: PageSpeedCare

sections.description:
PageSpeedCare Social Chat Widget is built for speed. Unlike other plugins that load multiple CSS and JS files, this plugin injects everything inline and only where it’s needed.

Features:
* NEW: Modern Premium Dashboard with Tabbed Navigation.
* NEW: Live Visual Preview for instant customization feedback.
* NEW: “Icons Only” mode for a clean, professional circular look.
* NEW: Data Cleanup Control – option to delete data on uninstall.
* Enable/Disable widget easily.
* Add multiple social channels (WhatsApp, Messenger, Telegram, etc.)
* Customizable Icons (SVG), Colors, and Backgrounds.
* 4 Positioning options.
* Attention-grabbing text feature with float animation.
* Zero external requests – for maximum PageSpeed score.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to ‘Settings > Social Chat Widget’ to configure your widget.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin affect my PageSpeed score?

No. It is designed to be ultra-lightweight. All assets load inline in the footer, so there are no extra HTTP requests that could slow down your site.

Can I add custom SVG icons?

Yes, you can paste your own SVG code directly into the social channel settings.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Major Feature: Redesigned Admin Dashboard with Tabbed Navigation.
  • Major Feature: Added Real-time Live Preview sidebar to the settings page.
  • Feature: Added “Icons Only” mode for a more compact circular design.
  • Improvement: Eliminated layout gap between attention text and icon for a cleaner look.
  • Improvement: Switched to iOS-style Toggle Switches in the dashboard.
  • Improvement: Card-based Social Channel management for better UX.
  • Fix: Corrected positioning logic and resolved JS console errors.
  • Compliance: Renamed all internal identifiers with pscscw_ prefix for better compatibility.
  • Compliance: Implemented proper WordPress asset enqueuing system.
  • Compliance: Added uninstall.php for clean data removal (optional).
  • Improvement: Expanded SVG whitelist for better custom icon support.
  • Improvement: Added settings migration logic for seamless updates from older versions.

1.0.2

  • Improved UX: Upward expansion logic (fixed trigger button).
  • Added smooth slide-up and fade-in animations.
  • Improved tooltip (attention text) positioning and animation.
  • Logic to transform Chat icon to Close icon when open.
  • Enhanced accessibility with ARIA labels.

1.0.1

  • Refined SVG sanitization for better icon support.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
